about.description:
A high-level Python interface to a generic, highly configurable Geant4
application. Event data is returned as awkward arrays.

Authors: Luis Antonio Obis Aparicio and Kavya Wadhwa.
about.summary: Python interface to a configurable Geant4 application

build.script: CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv -Ccmake.define.FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_AWKWARD-HEADERS=${{ SRC_DIR }}/deps/awkward-headers -Ccmake.define.FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_PYBIND11=${{ SRC_DIR }}/deps/pybind11

script: python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; assert g4.geant4_version == '11.4.3', g4.geant4_version"
python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; assert g4.files.datasets.installation_datasets(), 'datasets not found'"
python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; app = g4.Application(gdml=g4.basic_gdml, seed=1); app.__enter__(); events = app.run(10); assert len(events) == 10; app.__exit__(None, None, None)"

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.2.0"

package:
  name: geant4-python-application
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/g/geant4-python-application/geant4_python_application-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a4d3170f4557eb02b2fc036b23dcd5185be61e97fac7976c3e66637a5db0f5fd
  # Fetched by CMake at build time otherwise; provided as sources so the build
  # needs no network access. Keep these versions in sync with AWKWARD_VERSION
  # and PYBIND11_VERSION in the upstream CMakeLists.txt.
  - url: https://github.com/scikit-hep/awkward/releases/download/v2.6.9/header-only.zip
    sha256: 37012c62b6df2dbc38345be89cd339c09c78eb2fc166cbbeaa583eda22a20604
    target_directory: deps/awkward-headers
  - url: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11/archive/refs/tags/v2.13.6.tar.gz
    sha256: e08cb87f4773da97fa7b5f035de8763abc656d87d5773e62f6da0587d1f0ec20
    target_directory: deps/pybind11
  # the header-only awkward release does not include its licence
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-hep/awkward/v2.6.9/LICENSE
    sha256: f05e4e003fcfa5901be0d398805a8653aa1e95210433e00e89a4c5528491b4e6
    file_name: LICENSE
    target_directory: deps/awkward-license

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
  script:
    - >-
      CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
      ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
      -Ccmake.define.FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_AWKWARD-HEADERS=${{ SRC_DIR }}/deps/awkward-headers
      -Ccmake.define.FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_PYBIND11=${{ SRC_DIR }}/deps/pybind11

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core
    - setuptools-scm
    # version selected in variants.yaml; its run_exports pins the runtime
    - geant4
    # Geant4's CMake configuration looks these up
    - freetype
    - xerces-c
    - expat
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - awkward
    - vector
    - fsspec
    - pyarrow
    - awkward-pandas
    - numpy
    - requests
    - platformdirs
    - tqdm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - geant4_python_application
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; assert g4.geant4_version == '11.4.3', g4.geant4_version"
      # conda-forge's geant4 brings its datasets; nothing must be downloaded
      - python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; assert g4.files.datasets.installation_datasets(), 'datasets not found'"
      - python -c "import geant4_python_application as g4; app = g4.Application(gdml=g4.basic_gdml, seed=1); app.__enter__(); events = app.run(10); assert len(events) == 10; app.__exit__(None, None, None)"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python

about:
  summary: Python interface to a configurable Geant4 application
  description: |
    A high-level Python interface to a generic, highly configurable Geant4
    application. Event data is returned as awkward arrays.

    Authors: Luis Antonio Obis Aparicio and Kavya Wadhwa.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    # compiled in from their sources
    - deps/awkward-license/LICENSE
    - deps/pybind11/LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/lobis/geant4-python-application
  repository: https://github.com/lobis/geant4-python-application
  documentation: https://github.com/lobis/geant4-python-application/blob/main/INSTALLATION.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - kavyawadhwa134
